==Overview==
The '''SOOP StarCraft League 2024 AUTUMN''' ('''KB Live Mobile 2024 SSL AUTUMN'''), is an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]] & [[SOOP]].

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F62RYoGdXSQ</embedvideo>

==Tournament Information==
===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: {{abbr/Bo1}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered/17|ASL Season 17]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: First two matches: {{abbr/Bo1}} - Final three matches: {{abbr/Bo3}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** All matches: {{abbr/Bo7}}
